purpose: PU-1 export-path registry. Every function that writes, renders or targets an outbound location is listed as GATED (passes through the app.licensing seam / marks output) or INTERNAL_ONLY (private working set, with a reason). Verified by apps/backend/scripts/check_pu1_export_path_closure.py; a function on neither list fails the build. Adding an INTERNAL_ONLY entry is a reviewed change; there is no override.
